name: Fenris Isle
summary: Rot Hide gnolls and a rogue Scourge necromancer hold Fenris Isle in Lordamere Lake, off Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: A Fallen Stronghold on the Lake
sections.body: Fenris Keep once anchored Lordaeron’s military outpost on Fenris Isle. When the Scourge swept through northern Lordaeron, the garrison was slaughtered or fled into exile, leaving the island to the dead. Since then, Rot Hide gnolls have made it their stronghold, spreading a crude empire across the lake’s shores. The Forsaken of Silverpine Forest watch the island closely, fearing its entrenched inhabitants threaten their northern territories.

sections.title: The Master of Fenris Keep
sections.body: Thule Ravenclaw commands Fenris Keep from its crumbling stone halls. Once aligned with the Kirin Tor, the necromancer turned to the Scourge’s dark arts and bent the native gnolls to his will. His sorcery raises their fallen kin and fortifies the island against intrusion. From this isolated sanctuary, Thule oversees the lake’s ferry crossings. Forsaken scouts and Horde forces strike ahead of any greater threat, seeking to break his hold on the archipelago.

faq.answer: Fenris Isle lies in Lordamere Lake, off Silverpine Forest’s eastern coast. Before the Third War, it served as a fortress for the Kingdom of Lordaeron; now plague-ridden gnolls and Scourge servants infest it.

faq.q: Who controls Fenris Isle right now?
faq.answer: Rot Hide gnolls occupy Fenris Isle and hold Fenris Keep as their stronghold. Forsaken investigators seek to uncover the source of the growing threat.

faq.q: What happened to the humans who used to live here?
aliases: what happened to fenris keep humans
faq.answer: When the Scourge overran Lordaeron during the Third War, Fenris Keep’s human defenders and inhabitants were murdered or driven away. The fortress lay in ruins until gnolls and necromancers claimed its empty ramparts.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in attacking the island?
aliases: why do horde attack fenris isle
faq.answer: The Forsaken see the entrenched Rot Hide gnolls as a threat to Silverpine Forest and the nearby ferry crossing. Their agents seek help investigating and disrupting the island’s hostile forces.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you see Fenris Isle as an intolerable Scourge bastion in your own backyard. Relentless strikes are needed to keep Thule Ravenclaw’s Rot Hide gnolls from overrunning Silverpine’s eastern waters.
As Horde, you can help Forsaken agents investigate the Rot Hide gnolls and strike their stronghold across Lordamere Lake.
